constraints: Keep provider.runtime, Globals.Function.Runtime, per-function Runtime, and Terraform aws_lambda_function.runtime on one AWS Lambda runtime identifier that AWS still supports.
Raising the managed runtime can require Ruby language and gem changes; confirm handlers run on the replacement before deploying.

steps.instructions: Change the reported Runtime (or provider.runtime / terraform runtime) from ruby2.5 to a supported AWS Lambda Ruby identifier (see the replacement).
steps.title: Raise the AWS Lambda runtime

steps.instructions: Update every other SAM/CloudFormation Globals or function Runtime, serverless.yml provider or function runtime, Terraform aws_lambda_function.runtime, and CI deploy config that still pins ruby2.5.
steps.title: Align other runtime surfaces

verification.command: sam validate || serverless print || terraform validate
verification.purpose: Validate the updated SAM, Serverless Framework, or Terraform declaration before deploy.

rule.summary: The AWS Lambda runtimes table lists ruby2.5 under Deprecated runtimes with deprecation date 2021-07-30. AWS no longer applies security or other updates to that managed runtime.
rule.title: AWS Lambda Ruby 2.5 runtime is end-of-life
